title: Power Mobility Devices
cms_cov_policy: <p>CMS Pub. 100-03, Medicare National Coverage Determinations Manual, Chapter 1, Sections 280.1, 280.3, 280.16</p>
source_info: <p>Appendix A. List of References Reviewed but Not Cited in the Bibliography <em>(located in the Associated Documents section of this LCD, as an attachment) </em></p>
issue: <p>The proposed LCD proposes a not reasonable and necessary determination for Group 2 power wheelchairs (PWCs) with seat elevation systems (K0830 and K0831), based on the best available evidence. Per the National Coverage Determination (NCD) 280.16 Seat Elevation Equipment (Power Operated) on Power Wheelchairs, coverage of Group 2 PWCs with seat elevators would be determined at the MAC&#8217;s discretion.</p>
issue_change: <p>The final LCD includes coverage criteria for Group 2 power wheelchairs (PWCs) with seat elevation systems (K0830 and K0831) for beneficiaries whose primary means of mobility within the home is their PWC and who rely upon their upper extremities for transfers or mobility-related activities of daily living (MRADLs) when documentation from a licensed/certified medical professional (LCMP) confirms that the seat elevation system is medically necessary. The final LCD is being amended to incorporate stakeholders&#8217; suggestions received during the open comment period.</p>
